newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Comdial restarted as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Comdial restarted as buy.

text.p: --Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Thursday it re-initiated coverage of Comdial Corp with a buy rating. Comdial designs and manufactures small- and mid-sized business telecommunications systems.

--"We believe Comdial is undervalued at its current price of $6.25 and is trading at a 42 percent discount to the company's latest 12-month sales, 12.5 times our 1997 earnings estimate of $0.50 and 1.5 times book value," Rodman noted.
--It expects revenues and earnings to increase in the second half of 1996 as a result of new product introductions and a more aggressive marketing strategy.
